text:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for SOC2 evidence packet: need proof that keys associated with customer org `org-742` were rotated and a specific key KID `k-9f2a` was deactivated and deleted on 2025-11-12. Also need sample audit log slice showing API auth events + S3 export link. Please include repro/playback instructions we can run locally.

mike_sec: Thanks — we can provide rotation metadata and the keystore export. Will need to confirm retention window for auth logs (we keep raw auth logs 90 days, indexed events 365).@sarah_compliance can you confirm the exact retention policy text? :eyes:

sarah_compliance: Confirmed — retention: keystore metadata (rotation records) retained 7 years; raw auth logs retained 90 days; archival snapshots (s3) 3 years. I'll attach the policy page to the package.

jenny_infra: I can produce an S3 export of the audit logs for the date range. Export job id: export-20251112-3421. Link (internal): https://s3.redwood-inference.prod/exports/2025/11/12/export-20251112-3421.tar.gz (access controlled). Also adding presigned link for auditor: https://s3-presigned.example/exp-abc123 (expires in 72h).

auditor_jane: Need a log sample that includes: key lifecycle events (create/rotate/deactivate/delete), API auth token validations for org-742, and the server-side request id for one failed token auth on 2025-11-12 15:22:07 UTC. Could you highlight those lines?

keystore_bot: Keystore event dump (filtered) for k-9f2a:

```
2025-11-12T14:59:01Z INFO keystore.kms key_created kid=k-9f2a owner=org-742 created_by=automation rotation_policy=90d
2025-11-12T15:00:02Z INFO keystore.kms key_rotated kid=k-9f2a prev_kid=k-7b1c rotated_by=rotation-service
2025-11-12T15:22:07Z WARN keystore.kms key_deactivated kid=k-9f2a deactivated_by=ops_ticket#1234
2025-11-12T15:23:10Z INFO keystore.kms key_deleted kid=k-9f2a deleted_by=ops_ticket#1234 deletion_proof=/keystore/exports/2025-11-12/k-9f2a-manifest.json
```

mike_sec: Here's the auth event snippet (filtered by org-742 and the server request id).

```
2025-11-12T15:21:58Z INFO auth.verify token=*** redacted org=org-742 user_id=u-444 req_id=req-0a1b2c auth_status=success
2025-11-12T15:22:07Z ERROR auth.verify token=*** org=org-742 user_id=u-444 req_id=req-0a1b2c auth_status=failed reason=token_revoked
2025-11-12T15:22:08Z INFO api.gateway request_id=req-0a1b2c route=/v1/generate status=401
```

jenny_infra: Repro/playback steps for auditor-run (non-prod helper that replays logs and verifies artifacts):

1) Download export tarball and verify manifest checksum:
```
sha256sum export-20251112-3421.tar.gz
# compare to manifest: 3b2f...f9a
```
2) Inspect keystore manifest for k-9f2a:
```
jq '.keystore[] | select(.kid=="k-9f2a")' keystore-manifest.json
```
3) Replay auth trace locally (tool: rw-replay) using request id:
```
rw-replay --input logs/2025-11-12/auth.log --filter req_id=req-0a1b2c --assert token_revoked
```
Note: rw-replay is a read-only verifier, it does not modify any keys.

auditor_jane: Good — can you also confirm chain-of-custody for the export? We need who pulled the export and the S3 object version ids.

jenny_infra: Chain-of-custody: export-20251112-3421 created by automated-exporter@infra with run-id run-8c3b. S3 object versions: v1:3b2f...f9a, v2:4e5d...a1c (current). Logged in audit_events table: export_job=export-20251112-3421 actor=automated-exporter@infra ts=2025-11-12T16:00:05Z. I'll include the audit_events SQL snippet in the packet.

mike_sec: Regarding deletion proof — we have a signed manifest at /keystore/exports/2025-11-12/k-9f2a-manifest.json which lists KID, deletion timestamp, and a signature from HSM 2 with sig_id=sig-hsm-77. We can provide the manifest and the HSM attestation blob (redacted keys).

sarah_compliance: Auditors will also want the control reference: control CC8 (key lifecycle) and control AL1 (audit logging). I'll map the artifacts to the control text and add a short memo describing scope and sampling method (we sampled all events for that org on the date).

auditor_jane: OK thanks — final asks before we close the ticket: 1) include the keystore signed manifest, 2) S3 presigned link (72h), 3) the rw-replay command output (stdout) showing the assertion passed, 4) list of who accessed the export (principal emails). Can you have the package ready by EOD PT?

jenny_infra: Working on it, should be ready in ~3h. Adding the SQL snippet for access log pull: ```select principal, action, ts from audit_events where job_id='export-20251112-3421' order by ts;```

mike_sec: I'll attach HSM attestation blob and the keystore manifest (redacted in-channel, full artifact in package).

auditor_jane: Great — ping me when uploaded. :thumbsup:

sarah_compliance: Added note to evidence tracker (URL: https://evidence.redwood-inference.com/packets/2025-11-12-org742). Moving to review once uploads complete. :white_check_mark:
